lines.t: On the Sabbath, we lift our song,
Hearts united, where we belong.
We rest in peace, we rest in light,
Shabbat Shalom, the stars shine bright.
Shabbat Shalom, blessed be this day,
You made it for us in a holy way.
More than rest, more than peace divine,
A taste of heaven, beyond all time.
From the beginning, Your rhythm flows,
Through every heart Your blessing grows.
We lay our work, our worries down,
Shabbat Shalom, Your love surrounds.
Shabbat Shalom, blessed be this day,
You made it for us in a holy way.
More than rest, more than peace divine,
A taste of heaven, beyond all time.
Six days we labor, then comes the song,
Of joy and rest we've sought so long.
We enter in, our spirits free,
Shabbat Shalom, in harmony.
Shabbat Shalom, blessed be this day,
We walk in light and learn Your way.
We rest in You, let our spirits soar,
Forever and ever, Shabbat Shalom once more.
We keep it holy, keep it true,
Shabbat Shalom to me and you.
In peace we gather, in love we stay,
Shabbat Shalom, today and always.
